To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) existing techniques for cardinality estimation of subgraph matching queries are inaccurate, (ii) the performance of existing techniques varies significantly depending on the dataset, query, and the number of nodes in the graph, (iii) a simple sampling method, called online subgraph sampling (os sampling), outperforms existing techniques, and (iv) os sampling is robust to changes in the query, dataset, and the number or nodes in the graph.
